label: PSU / twisted A
construction: Actual standard Hermitian SU_n(K/F), quotiented by its proved full norm-one scalar center
parameters: F finite with q=|F|, K/F an actual quadratic extension; n is matrix dimension; stable catalogue: n>=3 and (n,q)!=(3,2)
exceptions: The full theorem covers n>=2 and has exactly (2,2), (2,3), (3,2) as nonsimple cases. Dimension two is retained through the actual PSU2(F)≃PSL2(F) comparison.
recognition: Direct finite Hermitian matrix construction, with actual field transport and SL graph-field fixed-subgroup identification; no order recognition, CFSG or projective fixed-point assertion
attribution: ATLAS quadratic-extension, Hermitian norm-count, Witt-coordinate, transvection and Iwasawa proofs; pinned mathlib field and matrix infrastructure

presentation.note: The catalogue table uses Lie rank n. Lean declarations use matrix dimension d=n+1 and q=|F|, not |K|=q^2. The complete dimension-d theorem begins at d=2 and has exactly three exceptions. The stable catalogue starts at d=3; dimension two has the actual PSL comparison. Field and fixed-subgroup equivalences are included verbatim in the public theorem extract.
